records.subject: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Rafael,

Wanted to check in on Blue Group's setup. If you haven't gotten to inviting the rest of the team yet, no rush -- just let me know if anything's in the way.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Blue Group set up
records.body:
Hi Rafael,

Welcome to Wrenfield. There's no wrong way to start -- create a project, add a few tasks, invite people, and adjust as you figure out what works for your team.

Reply here if you need a hand.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no key milestone, zero tickets, and no reply to either Wrenfield touch (email:37b7f477, email:5c9d2c2c). Silence plus three stall reasons on a Starter plan suggests low unaided odds of activating in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: One small next step for Blue Group
draft.body:
Hi Rafael,

Checking back on Blue Group in Wrenfield. Nothing's moved yet, and that's usually just a question of where to start: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so a single first project is enough to get going. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything as we go.

Best,
Priya
